integrationPolicy.doNotOverlapArea: Eastern elevated plateau / cliff road / housing plots
integrationPolicy.ourUse: Use as optional external content in the eastern high-ground residential district; Harborline remains in the original Docks region and will not duplicate Daffy's content.

permissionNotice: Author's Nexus page forbids modification of the mod and reuse of its assets without permission; do not redistribute this DLL or assets.

countClaims.discrepancy: The page title and feature-description house counts differ (30 vs 32). It also advertises 44 NPCs in the title while the feature list specifies 43 new customers plus a dealer. Do not treat these counts as runtime-verified from the DLL.

patchNotesCaveat: Version 1.1 patch notes mentioned police presence/world events as in progress; do not assume this feature is complete in 1.2 without an in-game check.
